text: Great for short breaks and relaxing gameplay. It is still one of the best casual puzzle games. The colorful graphics, frequent updates, and thousands of levels make it fun and engaging. It is perfect for relaxing and passing time. However, some higher levels are very challenging, and the game often encourages players to purchase boosters and extra moves. Overall, it is an addictive and entertaining game for puzzle lovers.

If you're one of those rare individual who've never heard of Candy Crush series. First of all, congratulation you lucky dog. Candy Crush Soda is like a drug pusher, the first one is free, and by first one I mean the first hundred or so level. But once you really get into it. Then it starts asking for money, in a very subtle way. A lot of level will magically comes to the point where you're one move or one jam, bear, bottle, or whatever euphoria inducing sweet away from winning. At which point you're only option is to either buy more moves, use some weapons, or give up and try again. And a lot of times the game will miraculously spawn a chocolate when you're near your last move just to lure you into buying more moves. If you're doing poorly near the beginning, near the end all of a sudden it'll generously spawn more same color candy to create chain reaction just so you feel like you're almost about to win. So TL;DR: boiling it down into a single compressed sentence. This game only wants your money. If you got deep pocket, or don't mind spending a lot of moolah, then go ahead. Otherwise, if you're looking for a fun puzzle game, look elsewhere, because this game have the tendency to manipulate the candy sequence into giving the players a false impression that they're actually playing a puzzle game when in reality this game is more similar IMHO to a fancy rigged slot machine, probably the most successful virtual slot machine ever created.

Overall, game can be a fun distraction. Some issues really need to be addressed though. Once again, (just as I'm out of lives) I get a free timed bonus. Whether these are 15 minutes or half hour, they've expired before I have even one life to play them. Since I play on my phone, if I take a call, again... bonuses expire. These should be set up so that if the game app is closed, bonus timers stop automatically. Not that complicated.
